verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart documents a first-party `custom_vocabulary_config` request parameter that takes a vocabulary list of domain terms and names (e.g. "Gladia", "Solaria", "Salesforce"), which directly delivers custom vocabulary for transcription accuracy. Custom spelling is a related normalization feature, not boosting, so it adds little here. missing for 10: documentation of boost intensity or weighting controls, confirmation that custom vocabulary works in live/real-time sessions, limits on vocabulary size, independent or hands-on corroboration of accuracy gains.
